Script shape per CLAUDE.md: loadEnvLocal() (copy from scripts/delete-ads-lead.ts:12-25), dynamic import of @prisma/client, dry run by default with a --write flag. Steps: (1) prisma.lead.findUnique({ where: { id }, select: { id, email, source, env, createdAt, notes } }) and assert email === "gtahomequest+ml013-homepage-valuation@gmail.com" and source === "homepage-valuation" before anything else; abort on any mismatch. (2) prisma.savedSearch.findMany({ where: { leadId: id } }) should return zero rows for this source; abort if not (purge-bot-leads.ts refuses when SavedSearch rows point at a lead). (3) prisma.leadActivity.findMany({ where: { leadId: id }, select: { type, payload } }) to record the Resend ids for the report, then prisma.lead.delete({ where: { id } }); LeadActivity cascades (schema.prisma LeadActivity onDelete: Cascade). Not reversible: the Resend log entries, the Upstash rate-limit tokens, the Meta CAPI event and the SMS; say so in the report. Note the Lead id is a cuid (schema.prisma Lead.id @default(cuid())), not a UUID, so delete-ads-lead.ts's UUID regex cannot be reused as is.
forms.risks:
1. RATE LIMIT COLLAPSE ACROSS THE WHOLE ML-013 RUN. The per-inbox key strips the plus-tag and Gmail dots (guards.ts:97-108), so every gtahomequest+ml013-<form>@gmail.com is ONE inbox: 3 submissions per hour and 6 per day (guards.ts:119-120), refused with 429 "Too many requests" (ingest.ts:233-237; guards.ts:159-164) which the form prints in its error div (HomeValuationCard.tsx:148). The IP gets 5 per 10 minutes and 12 per day (guards.ts:117-118). Drive at most 3 forms per hour and 6 per day from that inbox, or use a second inbox on a non-Gmail domain for the rest; a 429 here is the guard working, not this form failing.
2. SILENT SUCCESS. A honeypot value or a missing/quoted User-Agent returns 200 { ok: true } with no lead_id and no row (ingest.ts:190-194, 206-210; route.ts:43-45), and LEADS_API_ENABLED not "true" returns { ok: true, no_op: true } (route.ts:32-34); the UI shows the success card in every case. Assert lead_id in the response. Puppeteer's iPhone UA contains no quote characters and passes checkUserAgent (guards.ts:83-88).
3. ORIGIN. The same-origin fetch carries Origin https://miltonly.com, which hostAllowed accepts (guards.ts:47-74). A replayed request without Origin or Referer gets 403 "forbidden".
4. HYDRATION. Controlled inputs (lines 252, 265, 278); text typed before React hydrates is lost. Wait for the address input and network idle first.
5. CLIENT VALIDATION ORDER: address 4+ chars, email regex, exactly 10 phone digits, consent ticked (lines 111-126). The phone formatter drops a leading "1" (line 26), so "16478399090" becomes 647-839-9090 and still passes.
6. EMAIL FAILURE DOES NOT FAIL THE SUBMISSION. A Resend refusal still returns ok with lead_id (ingest.ts:343-353, 392-410); check LeadActivity for email_failed rows or the Resend log for the two ids before calling the email leg a pass.
7. CONFIRMATION COPY GAP (not a failure). "homepage-valuation" has no case in confirmationLineFor or confirmationSubject (notify.ts:32-137), so the submitter gets "I got your message" and "Your request is in. Aamir replies personally, during business hours." while the page and the success card promise a written valuation within 24 hours (ValuationBand.tsx:79; HomeValuationCard.tsx:223). The sibling sources sales-ads-home-valuation and street-valuation get the valuation subject (notify.ts:105-110). Worth a follow-up, outside a fix-only-if-broken brief.
8. PRODUCTION SIDE EFFECTS OF A TEST: a Meta CAPI Lead event worth 500 CAD reaches the real stream (ingest.ts:426-441), the SMS rings REALTOR_PHONE, and the ops alert lands in ALERT_EMAIL_TO with subject "New lead — homepage-valuation". Warn the desk before the run.
9. useSearchParams in the client card (line 89) reads ?street= into the address field; open the bare URL.

forms.risks: 1. Rate limit, the biggest one for the whole run: the inbox key collapses Gmail plus-tags (guards.ts:94-106), so every gtahomequest+ml013-<form>@gmail.com counts against ONE inbox: 3 per hour and 6 per day (guards.ts:116-119, 150-166); the IP gets 5 per 10 min and 12 per day. Upstash is configured in production (UPSTASH_REDIS_KV_REST_API_URL/TOKEN present), so the limits are real and shared across instances. The 4th submission within an hour gets 429 "Too many requests" and the form renders .s-alert-err. Space the forms (three per hour), or use a second inbox for the rest, and do not retry a failure inside the window. 2. Silent "success" without a row: a filled honeypot (`input[name="company_website"]`), a missing or quote-containing User-Agent, or LEADS_API_ENABLED not "true" all return 200 and the form shows the done text (route.ts:32-34, 41-45; guards.ts:34-40, 80-85). Puppeteer must not auto-fill every input; the iPhone UA must be a plain string. LEADS_API_ENABLED is present in the Vercel production env and "true" in .env.local. 3. Origin guard (guards.ts:55-70): only a same-origin fetch from the page passes; a bare node POST without Origin/Referer is 403. Drive the real form. 4. Hydration: onSubmit exists only after the client component hydrates; tapping earlier does a native GET submit. Wait for load/networkidle first and confirm the POST fires. 5. Selectors: the useId ids and names (`:R18ajttrcq:-email`, `:R18ajttrcq:-intent`) depend on the render tree and contain colons; use `form#capture` scoping instead. The unscoped first `button[type="submit"]` is the nav search. 6. The fixed 66px nav (site-nav.css:8-13, :63; hero padding-top 66px at street-theme.css:170-178) can cover an element scrolled to the top edge; scroll the form to center before tapping. No consent banner and no Crisp widget on /streets/ (ChromeGate.tsx:31 returns null, layout.tsx:149-151). 7. Native validation: `type="email" required` (StreetCapture.tsx:97-98) and `if (!email) return` (line 31) block an empty or malformed address before any POST; a plus-tag Gmail address passes both the browser and EMAIL_RE (ingest.ts:153, 218). 8. Side effects on a production test lead: an SMS to Aamir's phone, the ops alert to ALERT_EMAIL_TO and a Meta CAPI event fire (isCountable, env.ts:25-27). 9. A Resend failure does not fail the submission (ingest.ts:343-352): the row exists, LeadActivity holds email_failed, the form shows success. Check LeadActivity, not only the inbox.
